title: 防护手套的选择与使用
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/023_防护手套的选择与使用.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/023_防护手套的选择与使用/src.py

points.K1: 手套是皮肤外的又一层屏障
points.K3: 查说明书和耐化学性资料选手套
points.K4: 化学品会渗透，沾上就换
points.K5: 浸泡、强腐蚀、高毒：专用手套
points.K8: 戴着手套不碰公共物品
points.K9: 隔热、低温、防割，各用各的
points.S1: 选符合国家标准的合格手套

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣戴着一副丁腈手套，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing a pair of nitrile gloves waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲防护手套的选择与使用。
overlay: 防护手套的选择与使用

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰戴着薄手套，准备往烧杯里倒溶剂
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, wearing thin disposable gloves, is about to pour a solvent into a beaker.
shots.narration: 阿杰戴上薄手套，准备倒溶剂。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 手套指尖沾了一滴溶剂，阿杰没在意，又去拿手机
shots.prompt_en: A drop of solvent lands on his glove fingertip; he ignores it and reaches for a phone on the bench.
shots.narration: 手套沾了溶剂，他又伸手拿手机。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研抬手拦住他
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student raises a hand to stop him.
shots.narration: 小研说：等等，这样手套白戴了。

shots.section_title: 手套是皮肤外的又一层屏障
shots.scene: 手部轮廓上，皮肤外面再罩一层手套
shots.prompt_en: A hand outline with skin as the first layer and a glove as an extra outer layer. No people.
shots.narration: 皮肤是屏障，手套再加一层。
overlay: 手套是皮肤外的又一层屏障

shots.section_title: 手套是皮肤外的又一层屏障
shots.scene: 手部周围是液滴、火焰、冰晶和刀刃图标
shots.prompt_en: A hand icon surrounded by droplet, flame, ice crystal and blade icons. No people.
shots.narration: 手最容易受伤，烫、冻、割、腐蚀。

shots.section_title: 手套是皮肤外的又一层屏障
shots.scene: 一瓶无标注毒性的样品，旁边是手套图标
shots.prompt_en: An unlabeled sample vial next to a glove icon. No people.
shots.narration: 样品毒不毒，常常说不清。

shots.section_title: 手套是皮肤外的又一层屏障
shots.scene: 做化学实验的手一直戴着手套
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands work at a chemistry bench throughout the task. No faces.
shots.narration: 养成习惯，操作化学品戴手套。

shots.section_title: 没有万能手套
shots.scene: 一副丁腈手套挡住所有危害的想象泡泡，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A thought bubble showing one nitrile glove blocking every hazard, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 以为一副丁腈手套啥都能挡？

shots.section_title: 没有万能手套
shots.scene: 丁腈、乳胶、氯丁、丁基等几种手套并排
shots.prompt_en: Several glove types of different colors and thicknesses lie side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 不同材质，耐的化学品不一样。

shots.section_title: 没有万能手套
shots.scene: 乳胶手套挡住微生物图标，化学液滴却渗过去
shots.prompt_en: A latex glove blocks microbe icons but a chemical droplet seeps through it. No people.
shots.narration: 乳胶挡得住微生物，挡不住多数溶剂。

shots.section_title: 没有万能手套
shots.scene: 丁腈手套遇到酮类和氯代溶剂瓶，表面起皱
shots.prompt_en: A nitrile glove swells and wrinkles next to two blank solvent bottles. No people.
shots.narration: 丁腈遇酮类、氯代溶剂，很快失效。

shots.section_title: 没有万能手套
shots.scene: 手套和试剂瓶之间画等号连线
shots.prompt_en: A matching line connects a specific glove to a specific reagent bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 材质要对上你用的化学品。

shots.section_title: 查说明书和耐化学性资料选手套
shots.scene: 安全技术说明书翻到个体防护那一页，手套图标高亮
shots.prompt_en: A blank safety data sheet opens to a page with a highlighted glove icon. No people.
shots.narration: 先查安全技术说明书的防护部分。
overlay: 查说明书和耐化学性资料选手套

shots.section_title: 查说明书和耐化学性资料选手套
shots.scene: 耐化学性对照表，格子里只有颜色和图标
shots.prompt_en: A chemical resistance chart with colored cells and icons only, no text. No people.
shots.narration: 再查手套的耐化学性对照表。

shots.section_title: 查说明书和耐化学性资料选手套
shots.scene: 表格中两栏被放大：渗透时间、降解程度
shots.prompt_en: Two columns of the chart are magnified, shown with a clock icon and a cracked glove icon. No people.
shots.narration: 看两项：穿透时间和降解程度。

shots.section_title: 查说明书和耐化学性资料选手套
shots.scene: 设备和材料的危害图标指向不同手套
shots.prompt_en: Hazard icons of a hot plate, a sharp tool and a chemical bottle each point to a different glove. No people.
shots.narration: 按材料和设备的危害来选。

shots.section_title: 查说明书和耐化学性资料选手套
shots.scene: 王老师在课前讲解手套要求
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains glove rules to students before class.
shots.narration: 实验课上，按老师的手套规定。

shots.section_title: 查说明书和耐化学性资料选手套
shots.scene: 小研拿不准时，向王老师询问
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds two glove boxes and asks the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 拿不准，问导师和安全管理员。

shots.section_title: 化学品会渗透，沾上就换
shots.scene: 化学分子慢慢穿过手套层的剖面示意
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section showing chemical molecules slowly passing through a glove layer over time. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品会随时间慢慢渗过手套。
overlay: 化学品会渗透，沾上就换

shots.section_title: 化学品会渗透，沾上就换
shots.scene: 二氯甲烷、乙醚瓶旁的薄手套很快被穿透
shots.prompt_en: Two blank solvent bottles beside a thin glove that is quickly penetrated. No people.
shots.narration: 有的溶剂，很快就能穿透薄手套。

shots.section_title: 化学品会渗透，沾上就换
shots.scene: 手套里面出汗、外面沾液的剖面
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section of a glove with sweat inside and liquid on the outside. No people.
shots.narration: 里面出汗，外面沾液，都会渗透。

shots.section_title: 化学品会渗透，沾上就换
shots.scene: 日历一页页翻过，戴同一种手套的手部轮廓渐渐变暗
shots.prompt_en: Calendar pages flip by while a gloved hand outline gradually darkens. No people.
shots.narration: 有人长期戴错手套，毫无感觉。

shots.section_title: 化学品会渗透，沾上就换
shots.scene: 体检报告上一个异常的红色图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank health check report with one red warning icon. No people.
shots.narration: 直到体检，才发现身体出了问题。

shots.section_title: 化学品会渗透，沾上就换
shots.scene: 沾上溶剂的手套被摘下扔进收集桶，换新的
shots.prompt_en: A contaminated glove is removed into a waste bin and a new glove is put on. No faces.
shots.narration: 沾上化学品，马上摘下换新的。

shots.section_title: 化学品会渗透，沾上就换
shots.scene: 手套破口，操作停下，洗手后换新手套
shots.prompt_en: A torn glove; work stops, hands are washed and a new glove is put on. No faces.
shots.narration: 破了、湿了，停下，洗手再换。

shots.section_title: 化学品会渗透，沾上就换
shots.scene: 时钟和手套图标，按规程定期更换
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon next to a fresh pair of gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 没沾上，也按规程定期更换。

shots.section_title: 浸泡、强腐蚀、高毒：专用手套
shots.scene: 手浸入溶剂槽，普通薄手套被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A hand in a thin glove dipping into a solvent tray, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 手要浸到溶剂里，薄手套不行。
overlay: 浸泡、强腐蚀、高毒：专用手套

shots.section_title: 浸泡、强腐蚀、高毒：专用手套
shots.scene: 换上厚的专用材质手套
shots.prompt_en: A thick, chemical-specific glove replaces the thin one. No people.
shots.narration: 浸泡作业，换专用材质的手套。

shots.section_title: 浸泡、强腐蚀、高毒：专用手套
shots.scene: 长到手臂的橡胶手套处理腐蚀品
shots.prompt_en: Long-cuff rubber gloves reaching up the forearm handle a corrosive bottle. No faces.
shots.narration: 强腐蚀品，戴长到手臂的橡胶手套。

shots.section_title: 浸泡、强腐蚀、高毒：专用手套
shots.scene: 耐酸手套挡住酸液
shots.prompt_en: An acid-resistant glove stops a splash of acid. No people.
shots.narration: 处理酸，选耐酸手套。

shots.section_title: 浸泡、强腐蚀、高毒：专用手套
shots.scene: 双层手套剖面：外层破了，内层完好
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section of double gloves: the outer layer is torn, the inner layer stays intact. No people.
shots.narration: 高毒作业戴双层，外层破了内层挡。

shots.section_title: 浸泡、强腐蚀、高毒：专用手套
shots.scene: 风险评估表旁的手套组合
shots.prompt_en: A blank risk assessment form next to a chosen glove combination. No people.
shots.narration: 怎么组合，先做风险评估。

shots.section_title: 大小合适，戴前检查
shots.scene: 小、中、大三副手套比在手上
shots.prompt_en: Small, medium and large gloves are held up next to a hand. No people.
shots.narration: 选合手的尺寸，太松太紧都不好。

shots.section_title: 大小合适，戴前检查
shots.scene: 【实拍】戴前检查手套：对着光看，卷起袖口挤住空气看有无漏气（手部特写，固定机位）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands holding a glove up to the light, then rolling the cuff to trap air and check for leaks.
shots.narration: 戴前检查，看有没有破口。

shots.section_title: 大小合适，戴前检查
shots.scene: 有小孔的手套被放进垃圾桶
shots.prompt_en: A glove with a pinhole is dropped into a bin. No people.
shots.narration: 有破损，直接换一副。

shots.section_title: 大小合适，戴前检查
shots.scene: 一次性手套被打上不能重复使用的标记
shots.prompt_en: A used disposable glove with a no-reuse icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一次性手套，不重复用。

shots.section_title: 翻着摘手套，摘完洗手
shots.scene: 捏住指尖往下拽，污染沾到手上，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Pulling a glove off by the fingertips spreads contamination onto the bare hand, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 捏着指尖拽，污染就到了手上。

shots.section_title: 翻着摘手套，摘完洗手
shots.scene: 【实拍】捏住一只手套腕部外侧，边往下剥边翻过来（手部特写，固定机位）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: one gloved hand pinches the outside of the other glove at the wrist and peels it off inside out.
shots.narration: 捏住腕部外侧，翻着剥下来。

shots.section_title: 翻着摘手套，摘完洗手
shots.scene: 脱下的手套团在戴手套的手心
shots.prompt_en: The removed glove is balled up in the palm of the still-gloved hand. No faces.
shots.narration: 把脱下的这只，团在手心。

shots.section_title: 翻着摘手套，摘完洗手
shots.scene: 【实拍】裸手手指伸进另一只手套内侧，翻转剥下，把第一只包在里面（手部特写，固定机位）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: bare fingers slide inside the cuff of the remaining glove and peel it off, wrapping the first glove inside.
shots.narration: 裸手伸进内侧，翻转剥下包起来。

shots.section_title: 翻着摘手套，摘完洗手
shots.scene: 包好的手套丢进指定收集容器
shots.prompt_en: The wrapped gloves are dropped into a designated waste container. No people.
shots.narration: 按规定丢进指定容器。

shots.section_title: 翻着摘手套，摘完洗手
shots.scene: 洗手池前认真洗手
shots.prompt_en: Hands are washed thoroughly at a lab sink. No faces.
shots.narration: 摘完手套，认真洗手。

shots.section_title: 翻着摘手套，摘完洗手
shots.scene: 阿杰对着空手练习翻摘动作
shots.prompt_en: The young male student practices the glove removal motion.
shots.narration: 平时多练几遍，形成习惯。

shots.section_title: 戴着手套不碰公共物品
shots.scene: 戴手套的手碰门把手、开关、手机，留下污染印，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands leave contamination marks on a door handle, a light switch and a phone, crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 戴着手套，别碰门把手和开关。
overlay: 戴着手套不碰公共物品

shots.section_title: 戴着手套不碰公共物品
shots.scene: 污染印从计算器、电脑传到别人手上
shots.prompt_en: Contamination marks spread from a calculator and a keyboard to another person's hand. No faces.
shots.narration: 化学品会到处“搬家”，传给别人。

shots.section_title: 戴着手套不碰公共物品
shots.scene: 笔被放进嘴里，打叉；旁边是禁止饮食标志
shots.prompt_en: A pen near a mouth crossed out with a red X, beside a no eating or drinking sign. No faces.
shots.narration: 笔放进嘴里，化学品就进了身体。

shots.section_title: 戴着手套不碰公共物品
shots.scene: 记录本、手机、电脑放在清洁区
shots.prompt_en: A notebook, a phone and a laptop sit in a separate clean area away from the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 记录本、手机放在清洁区。

shots.section_title: 戴着手套不碰公共物品
shots.scene: 离开操作区先摘手套、洗手，再去写记录
shots.prompt_en: A person removes gloves and washes hands before writing in a notebook. No faces.
shots.narration: 先摘手套洗手，再碰公共物品。

shots.section_title: 隔热、低温、防割，各用各的
shots.scene: 隔热手套从烘箱取出热烧杯
shots.prompt_en: Heat-resistant gloves lift a hot beaker out of an oven. No faces.
shots.narration: 拿热的东西，戴隔热手套。
overlay: 隔热、低温、防割，各用各的

shots.section_title: 隔热、低温、防割，各用各的
shots.scene: 徒手碰热器皿，打叉；隔热手套挂在伸手可及处
shots.prompt_en: A bare hand reaching for hot glassware is crossed out; heat gloves hang within easy reach. No people.
shots.narration: 别徒手碰热的，隔热手套要常备。

shots.section_title: 隔热、低温、防割，各用各的
shots.scene: 低温手套取干冰和超低温冰箱里的样品
shots.prompt_en: Cryogenic gloves take a sample box from an ultra-low freezer next to dry ice. No faces.
shots.narration: 取干冰、超低温样品，戴低温手套。

shots.section_title: 隔热、低温、防割，各用各的
shots.scene: 防割手套搬运锋利的板材边角料
shots.prompt_en: Cut-resistant gloves carry sharp sheet metal scraps. No faces.
shots.narration: 处理锐器、搬板材，戴防割手套。

shots.section_title: 隔热、低温、防割，各用各的
shots.scene: 长板两人一起抬，废金属分类放入回收箱
shots.prompt_en: Two people carry a long board together; metal scraps go into a sorted recycling bin.
shots.narration: 长板两人抬，废料分类回收。

shots.section_title: 隔热、低温、防割，各用各的
shots.scene: 振动工具和搬运重物，各配对应手套
shots.prompt_en: A vibrating tool and a heavy box, each paired with a matching glove icon. No people.
shots.narration: 振动、搬运，也各有专用手套。

shots.section_title: 选符合国家标准的合格手套
shots.scene: 手套包装上的合格标识和防护图标被放大
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a glove package showing a quality mark and protection icons. No text.
shots.narration: 选符合国家标准的合格手套。
overlay: 选符合国家标准的合格手套

shots.section_title: 选符合国家标准的合格手套
shots.scene: 无标识的散装手套，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A loose pile of unmarked gloves crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 看清防护类型，不用来路不明的。

shots.section_title: 选符合国家标准的合格手套
shots.scene: 实验室负责人登记手套配备
shots.prompt_en: The older man checks a glove supply shelf and ticks a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 实验室按危害配好，用完补齐。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 手套、说明书、对照表依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: A glove, a safety data sheet and a resistance chart get green checks one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 按化学品选材质，戴前查破损。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 沾污就换、翻着摘、不碰公共物品依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons for changing a contaminated glove, removing inside out and not touching a door handle get green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 沾了就换，翻着摘，不碰公共物品。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣穿着扣好的实验服，挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing a fully buttoned lab coat waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲实验服与防护服。
